about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all six shots and recorded in README.md's capture block: window 1440x763 on the deployed build at ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.boot(); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30), then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot, vitals pinned at 100, the level's own hostiles cleared (never DEV.clear()), level banner taken down with banner('', 0). A frozen clock does not stop S.t, so these frames are reproducible by statistics and never by md5. **One term this plan did not record: the audio device.** A live boot advances the seeded stream through SND.init's noise buffer before the generator runs, so one seed deals one level per sample rate (#404, and the rule the tool prints as HW_WHY). These six captures read no SND.ac.sampleRate, so every row carries `sampleRate: null`, `check` prints each one as a device-scoped deal, and the binding below is per-machine: it says this frame is what ?dev=1&seed=60 dealt on the capture's audio device, not that every machine deals it. `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` gates the missing term. A capture that reads the rate turns its own row into a cross-machine binding with no change to the tool.

shots.note: Deal transcribed from README.md's capture block, which names all six shots as one route: the deployed page opened at ?dev=1&seed=60, build proved by eval-visible code markers, every deployed js blob md5-identical to the tree at ce9d39d. layout is that block's DEV.layoutSig() for the deal. Pose: one posed grunt 6 m out on the camera's own band (a posed body added with DEV.spawn, never DEV.clear, which would leave 0 LEFT on the HUD).

Same route as level0-spawn; see that row for where each field was recorded. Shot 8be1f96 is the one whose caption names black air above the four risers - the reason #333 reopened, and the reason this artifact exists.
Same route as level0-spawn. Feet on floor -1.00 in the pit, lamp at (20.5, 16.5) one cell over - a pose named in the caption, so the deal field is what makes it re-takeable rather than a description.
Same route as level0-spawn. The pit lip from 2.5 m out; the props the caption counts (9 lamps, 7 crates, 7 barrels) are this deal's, which is why seed and layout are gated and the counts are not.

The reference shot for the block: the route and every deal field in these six rows are transcribed from README.md's capture block (deployed build, ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.layoutSig 735688443, js blobs md5-identical to ce9d39d) rather than re-measured here. #335 measured this route: reloading the same URL read DEV.seed 60 and layout 735688443 on both loads, which is what makes origin+install=url-open a binding route.

Re-taken from the deployed Pages build of main, which is the only route that can answer #431: the frame the README printed was drawn at cd191ca, where this level's walls carried WT.STONE, and 56d87b6 (#369/#428) repaints those faces WT.SLAB. The build is proved off the wire, not from memory: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs the page served were md5-compared against origin/main at 12bdefa and all twelve matched, so these pixels came off the page that serves 12bdefa - nothing here is filled in from a local tree (#395, #420).  Route is the URL itself, unchanged: headless Chromium opened this row's url at a 1440x763 device-metrics override at scale 1 and, once the page reported ready, ran DEV.boot(); startLevel(3, true); banner('', 0); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; DEV.cam(1.5, 2.5, floorAt(1.5, 2.5), 0.60, 0); DEV.tick(1), leaving the level's own 4 hostiles standing (grunt, grunt, hound, brute, all asleep - no DEV.clear); S.mode read 'play' before and after the shutter with no resume() needed; props 9, SND.ac.sampleRate 44100, DEV.state().gnd jit 1 jitMinPx 48 light 1 ax 1 filt 1 ramp 1 far 1 fade 1 mipax 1 mipar 4. Re-encoded as colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js (--check reports type 2 1440x763, no alpha).  WHAT MOVED, against the bytes this row replaces (ddad0be2, drawn at cd191ca): mean 50.14 -> 66.75, thirds 41.16/58.48/50.83 -> 45.58/76.05/78.71, dark rows at the tool's threshold 24 stay 0 of 763 (at 34: 0 -> 46, longest run 38 from row 260), and 697,059 of 1,098,720 px shift by more than 2 luma (63.44 %, mean |delta| over those px 26.6, worst 173, 92,874 px over 50, spread by third 133,474/237,642/325,943) - the whole frame, not one bright patch. That is far more than a material swap at equal albedo and this row does not pretend to separate its causes. Three are in the tree between the two builds: the wall repaint #428; #413's ceiling fittings, which put a visible light source in this room's air (this run counts 11 lights where the replaced row counted 7); and the deck/light work #19 and #408. By band the lit floor moves 64.34 -> 97.17 and the wall patch x 660-1295 x y 340-422 moves 81.93 -> 100.38, so the deck gained more than the wall did - the page capture cannot split them and this row does not try.  The fourth cause is the deal, and it is the one this row can name exactly: DEV.layoutSig() read 972763321 on the capturing run and 164933889 on a second run of the same route at the same build, so on this build the layout the shutter drew is a property of the run, not of the url - the term #420 exists to remove, recorded here rather than re-run until a favourite number came back. Two shutters of one pose differ in 17,567 of 1,098,720 px (1.60 %, worst 6 luma): that is route noise, an order of magnitude below the move.  Geometry is not among the things that moved, and the caption still asserts it, so it was read back off the same page at this seat: own floor 0.00, own ceiling 1.00, MAP.cz 4, MAP.light 0.102, and the seventh cell along the heading (7.28, 6.45) is air at floor 0.00 with its ceiling solving at 4.00. The frame mean this row carries (66.75) is the number README.md's decode list and this caption quote. #431 is the re-take, #395 the caption that cannot go false, #420 the stream pin that would make a re-take a fact of the url.
